item.title: World Cup Could Help Reverse U.S. Tourism Slide
item.description: Mega sporting events are a big pull for travelers, and could help the U.S. overcome other forces keeping tourists away.

item.title: Skift Megatrends Debate: How Fast Will AI Disrupt Travel?
item.description: A VC and Skift research analyst agreed AI will transform travel distribution. They disagreed on timing — and on whether consumers will trust a machine with their most consequential purchases.

item.title: Capital One Gets Deeper Into Business Travel With $5 Billion Brex Acquisition
item.description: Capital One is ambitiously building out its travel business and tech stack. It also recently acquired Discover, which will add to the mix.

item.title: Why Ixigo’s Singapore Arm Points to Potential Overseas Acquisition
item.description: Ixigo has done much of the heavy lifting in the domestic market. Outbound travel, though, plays by different rules as it needs global supply and boots on the ground. An overseas acquisition makes for a far more realistic entry point.

item.title: The Premium Arms Race: Delta Leads, United Is Gaining Fast
item.description: Delta was first to recognize that premium demand would become the industry’s profit engine. But United has been aggressive at expanding premium capacity — and is closing the gap quickly.

item.title: Saudi Arabia Reports 5% Gain in 2025 Visits, Tops 120 Million
item.description: With nearly 80% of the upcoming hotel supply concentrated in the luxury and upscale tiers, there is a need to rebalance the pipeline.

item.title: Airlines Brace for Disruptions as Winter Storm Snarls U.S.
item.description: The storm is expected to bring heavy snow, sleet, and freezing rain from the Southern Rockies to New England through Monday.

item.title: From Vibe Coding to Exclusive LLM Deals: AI Takeaways From Agoda’s CEO
item.description: Travel industry employees, whether they work for Agoda or somewhere else, need to adapt to AI workflows. If they don't they'll be obsolete and looking for new jobs.

item.title: ‘Nobody Wants to Pay More’: TotalEnergies CEO Blames Airlines for Green Fuel Roadblocks
item.description: If fossil fuel producers like TotalEnergies won’t invest in green jet fuel, the aviation industry’s climate goals could be grounded.

item.title: Sabre Exec on the Agentic Shift: ‘This Is Augmentation, Not Displacement’
item.description: Sabre’s agentic AI pushes travel agencies to rethink their roles, in a move that’s drawing both interest and unease. Here’s how the company is making that case.
